about: What the app's Send feedback posts (lib/core/feedback/feedback.dart, buildFeedbackPayload) and what the website's feedback address must accept (web/lib/feedback.ts). Read by test/core/feedback_test.dart AND web/tests/feedback.test.ts: 'input' goes into the app's function and must give exactly 'payload' (same keys, same order); 'payload' is posted to the website's handler, which must answer ok and write a mail with 'mail'. Change the schema on both sides, then this file.
